FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Find answers to the most common questions about PlasmAI

data.q1: Is my health data safe with PlasmAI?
data.an1: Absolutely. Your privacy is our number one priority. We do not store your reports. They are processed temporarily and permanently deleted after your session.
data.an2: No. PlasmAI is an informational tool, not a doctor. Think of it as a smart assistant that helps you understand your results so you can have a more informed conversation with your healthcare provider.
data.q3: Where does the information for recommendations come from?
data.an3: All our recommendations (for nutrition, supplements, etc.) are generated based on information from high-quality, evidence-based sources. This includes peer-reviewed scientific journals, clinical guidelines from leading health organizations, and established medical research.
data.q4: Can the AI handle different lab formats and languages?
data.an4: Yes. Our Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology is designed to be robust and can handle a wide variety of common lab report layouts. Additionally, our system supports analysis in multiple languages, and we are constantly expanding this capability.
